title: Lae HEAVY TRUCK MECHANICS
industry: Heavy Equipment, Logistics, Transport and Supply, Mechanical
description:
LAE HEAVY TRUCK MECHANICS
EFM is the largest independent, international logistics provider of sea, air and road freight movements in PNG. EFM has regional foot print throughout the South Pacific and Australia. As part of our structural improvement and to cater for the needs of our expanding customer base, an exciting opportunity exists within our
Workshop Team in Lae
.
JOB REQUIREMENTS:
Be able to read, write and speak English to a good standard.
Be reliable, on-time and able to work for extended hours, if required.
Have 5 years experience working within the heavy vehicle industry, trucks, forklifts, trailers and gear boxes repairs.
The right applicant must have the ability to work on their own and also part of a team.
The candidate must be hard working, self-motivated and energetic and have work done attitude
QUALIFICATIONS:
Be in possession of a PNG’s Trade qualification.
Experience and references from reputable employers.
Have a current driver’s license.
Have a current Police Clearance.
Apply by email at
[email protected]
with your relevant documents.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Do not apply if above requirements are not met as you will not receive our reply.
